mapper.select: SELECT EXPENSE_ID AS expenseId, ID AS id, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, AMOUNT AS amount, SPENT_AT AS spentAt FROM EXPENSE_CATEGORY WHERE EXPENSE_ID = #{expenseId} AND ID = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXPENSE_CATEGORY (ID, CATEGORY_NAME, AMOUNT, SPENT_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{categoryName}, #{amount}, #{spentAt})
